notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.76

• DuckAI is awake from the moment the phone starts, and stays awake: Duckling's brain is loaded as DuckOS comes up and the phone never takes it back for memory (Settings › DuckAI › Keep DuckAI ready).
• Beta Store: the phone's app store, with the whole Google Play catalogue, now as DuckOS's own store (built from Aurora Store's code). It replaces Aurora Store.
• DuckPay: a card can keep its security code (CVV/CVC), sealed with the number and shown or filled only after your fingerprint, face or PIN, so paying online is one tap. Add it when you add a card.
• DuckPay from the power button with the screen off stays on screen (it used to close itself a moment after appearing).
• DuckWallet 3.0.5: asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN each time it opens; the security code field; "Show the number and code".
• Settings: Report a bug and Medical ID have the Settings top like every other page; Back from Passwords goes back to Settings (not to DuckCloud); after opening a search result, Back brings the search and its results back.
• Swiping down on the home opens the phone's own notification shade and Quick Settings.
• The keyboard's hide arrow sits at the bottom right (from 1.0.75).
